edits.label: add lang+copy
edits.find:
import { CircleCheckBig, Hash, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "@lucide/astro";
---

edits.label: empty+results
edits.find:
<EmptyState
      id="emptyState"
      title="Enter a number to check"
      description="Whether it's prime, its factors, and nearby primes will appear here."
    />

    <ResultsGrid id="resultsContainer" hidden>
      <ResultCard id="isPrimeResult" title="Result" icon={CircleCheckBig} accent="primary" size="lg" />
      <ResultCard id="factorsResult" title="Factors" icon={Hash} accent="neutral" />
      <ResultCard id="nearestBelowResult" title="Nearest Prime Below" icon={ArrowLeft} accent="neutral" />
      <ResultCard id="nearestAboveResult" title="Nearest Prime Above" icon={ArrowRight} accent="neutral" />
    </ResultsGrid>
edits.replace:
<EmptyState
      id="emptyState"
      title={copy.emptyTitle}
      description={copy.emptyDesc}
    />

    <ResultsGrid id="resultsContainer" hidden>
      <ResultCard id="isPrimeResult" title={copy.result} icon={CircleCheckBig} accent="primary" size="lg" />
      <ResultCard id="factorsResult" title={copy.factors} icon={Hash} accent="neutral" />
      <ResultCard id="nearestBelowResult" title={copy.nearestBelow} icon={ArrowLeft} accent="neutral" />
      <ResultCard id="nearestAboveResult" title={copy.nearestAbove} icon={ArrowRight} accent="neutral" />
    </ResultsGrid>

edits.label: wire calcLang
edits.replace:
<script define:vars={{ calcLang: lang, primeLabel: copy.prime, notPrimeLabel: copy.notPrime, noneLabel: copy.none, fillNumberMsg: copy.fillNumber }}>
  window.calcLang = calcLang;
  window.pnPrimeLabel = primeLabel;
  window.pnNotPrimeLabel = notPrimeLabel;
  window.pnNoneLabel = noneLabel;
  window.pnFillNumberMsg = fillNumberMsg;
</script>
<script src="../../scripts/prime-number-calculator.ts"></script>

edits.label: translate validate
translate copy summary
add lang
fillNumber error
result labels
